item.description:
SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR [NEW_] IN INCHEON (1080p HD)​


​
In April 2025, Seventeen announced their fifth studio album Happy Burstday. During the announcement for the album, they also revealed that they would be embarking on a new world tour. The tour was officially announced on July 23, set to start with two nights in Incheon, South Korea, and an announcement for ten shows in Japan came later that day. The promotional poster included only nine members, with Jeonghan and Wonwoo both having begun their enlistment periods prior to the band's Right Here World Tour, and Hoshi and Woozi beginning their services after the duo's Warning Tour. The first two shows will be broadcast live via Weverse.
